FEAT-003's InterPresenceCoordinator must become the single writer of that state and own the paused (3) transitions from the camera-state machine; it should keep calling the same -setPresenceMonitoringState: with the same 0/1/2/3 encoding. Do not add a second writer.

== DEVIATIONS FROM THE PLAN, WITH REASONS ==
1. §7.4 item 2 is NOT verbatim. Plan item 13(b) asks for it verbatim; plan item 16 asks for a blanket §7.10 word check. The verbatim sentence contains four forbidden words ("emotion, mood, attention, confidence"), so the two requirements are mutually exclusive. The negative list is reproduced in plain language with the same substance and the same prominence (its own visually distinct block, six explicit "we do not" lines), and the deviation is recorded in a doc comment on PresenceDisclosure. Choosing the other way round would have made the copy guard untestable as specified.
2. activePresenceMonitoringArmed is NOT set on the host-create path, because /room/create returns no presence block (confirmed in FEAT-001 and in index.js) — there is no server answer to read. Rather than put a client claim in a property whose name states a server fact, the create branch sets a separately named activePresenceMonitoringRequested, and the interviewer's ONE `if` reads the computed activePresenceSurfaceVisible (armed || requested). Nothing is authorised by it: the chip's state comes from the server's timeline response (an unarmed room yields monitoringEnabled false -> the chip reads "Presence monitoring off", which is true), and the detector is gated on activePresenceMonitoringGranted, which only the candidate's consent screen writes and only on the join path.
3. The POST to /presence/consent lives at ONE site in -enterMode:'s isInterviewee branch, not at the two routing sites the plan named (AppDelegate ~1340-1356 and ~2239-2252). Both of those branches — and the lobby-admitted path — converge on enterMode, so one guard covers all three instead of duplicating two. Same for the interviewer surface.
4. The host view gained a SECOND @objc initializer, init(detailsWithFrame:monitoringState:retentionDays:rightsContact:externalDisplayPolicy:), because `.details` is a view STATE while `mode:` carries a PresenceConsentMode raw value; adding a fourth mode case would have polluted the pure mode() function the zero-impact test enumerates. A legacyAlert raw value passed to the consent initializer falls back to the monitoring-off notice so a programming error can never present the monitored offer.
5. Two extra @objc members beyond the plan's list, both for honesty rather than features: InterPresenceConsentHostView.setMonitoringState(_:) (so an open details sheet cannot show a stale state) and InterCallControlBarBridge.setPresenceStatusText(_:) / setPresenceRecordingAvailable(_:) (so a failed timeline read says so instead of rendering an empty list that reads as "nothing happened", and so Jump is enabled only when a recording genuinely exists — latched from InterRecordingCoordinator.state in this session).
6. jumpTo routes to the existing recordings panel (toggleNormalRecordingListPanel) and logs the offset; it does not seek. Plan item 15(e) records that building a player is out of scope. The control is DISABLED with the caption "No recording for this session" rather than hidden.

== NOT DONE, DELIBERATELY ==
No detector, no Vision import, no AVCaptureSession, no capture source, no event engine, no reporter, no coordinator — all of that is FEAT-003. No InterLocalMediaController was touched and recordingFrameObserver was not co-opted. No head pose, gaze, iris, blink/EAR, landmarks, room scan, virtual-camera detection, audio signal, server-side frame analysis or frame retention. No aggregate score, index, percentage, rating, risk level or candidate-to-candidate comparison anywhere in the view models, the views, the labels or the export path. No automated action: the interviewer surface offers no action against the candidate at all. No blocking consent variant — both join buttons are the same width and the same InterControl.primaryHeight, both use the .primary variant, neither is greyed and the decline is not a link. No face identity verification. No new InterNetworkErrorCode, no change to isExpectedJoinRejection, no edit to project.pbxproj, and no git command of any kind.
